titleText: JTF News: BBC News, Deutsche Welle
mainText: Twenty-one people, including eight children, died after a building collapsed in Gaza, according to rescuers.
Sweden's center-left bloc is projected to win the election according to STV reporting.
The House considers bills on Russia sanctions and artificial intelligence data center costs.
The U.S. Federal Reserve raised its key interest rate for the first time in 3 years.
A Russian drone attack on a bus in Ukraine's southeast killed five people.
